Weighted Job Scheduling:
import bisect
n=int(input());J=sorted((tuple(map(int,input().split())) for _ in range(n)),key=lambda j:j[1])
ends=[j[1] for j in J];dp=[0]*(n+1)
for i,(s,e,p) in enumerate(J,1):
    k=bisect.bisect_right(ends,s,0,i-1)
    dp[i]=max(dp[i-1],dp[k]+p)
print(dp[n])
Minimum Spanning Tree:
n,m=map(int,input().split());E=sorted((tuple(map(int,input().split())) for _ in range(m)),key=lambda e:e[2]);p=list(range(n+1))
def f(x):
    while p[x]!=x: p[x]=p[p[x]];x=p[x]
    return x
t=c=0
for u,v,w in E:
    a,b=f(u),f(v)

Count Inversions:
import sys
sys.setrecursionlimit(10000)
input();a=list(map(int,input().split()))
def ms(a):
    if len(a)<2: return a,0
    m=len(a)//2;l,x=ms(a[:m]);rr,y=ms(a[m:]);o=[];i=j=0;c=x+y
    while i<len(l) and j<len(rr):
        if l[i]<=rr[j]: o.append(l[i]);i+=1
        else: o.append(rr[j]);j+=1;c+=len(l)-i
    o+=l[i:];o+=rr[j:]
    return o,c
print(ms(a)[1])
Minimum Window Substring:
from collections import Counter
s=input().strip();t=input().strip();need=Counter(t);miss=len(t);best=-1;l=0
for r_,c in enumerate(s):
    if need[c]>0: miss-=1
    need[c]-=1
    if miss==0:
        while need[s[l]]<0: need[s[l]]+=1;l+=1
        if best<0 or r_-l+1<best: best=r_-l+1
        need[s[l]]+=1;miss+=1;l+=1
print(best)
N-Queens Count:
n=int(input())
def go(row,c,d1,d2):
    if row==n: return 1
    t=0;free=~(c|d1|d2)&((1<<n)-1)
    while free:
        b=free&-free;free-=b
        t+=go(row+1,c|b,(d1|b)<<1,(d2|b)>>1)
    return t
print(go(0,0,0,0))
